log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Garchomp
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Charizard

decisions.rationale: Down 0-1; opponent leads CharY+Venusaur every game. Gholdengo blocks Sleep Powder via Good as Gold and 4x hits CharY with Power Gem. Farigiraf Protects turn 1, sets TR turn 2 (Armor Tail blocks Raichu FakeOut). Mudsdale's Occa Berry+Stamina and Azumarill's Huge Power crush under TR. No Mega on my team.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur every game (confirmed G1). Venusaur used Protect turn 5 of G1. CharY uses SolarBeam and Heat Wave freely under Drought. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks all priority (FakeOut/Nuzzle). Under Trick Room, my 49-63 Spe mons outspeed their 132-167 range. Plan for G3 if needed: consider Rotom-Wash for Hydro Pump pressure if they adapt lead.

decisions.rationale: Commit to Mega Charizard Y. Charizard/Venusaur immediately pressure Gholdengo and aim Sleep Powder at Farigiraf to delay Trick Room; Wide Lens improves that key line. Garchomp supplies Ground/Rock coverage once Charizard is positioned safely, while Primarina is a slow-mode answer to Azumarill, Mudsdale, and a successful Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Opponent used a Farigiraf-centered Trick Room mode in game 1. Farigiraf has Armor Tail, Sitrus Berry, and showed turn-1 Protect before attempting Trick Room after waking. Gholdengo is Life Orb and showed Protect. Mega Charizard Y/Venusaur sun pressure with Sleep Powder remains the primary anti-TR plan; Fake Out is blocked while Farigiraf is active.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Gholdengo Protects to avoid the OHKO Heat Wave under sun. Farigiraf sets Trick Room, surviving 32-44% from spread Heat Wave even if Venusaur chips. If Trick Room goes up, my slow Mudsdale/Azumarill outspeed everything. Venusaur's Sleep Powder is inaccurate (82.5%) and Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks it anyway. This is the safest path to the win condition.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games (consistent). G1 Venusaur Protected turn 5. CharY uses SolarBeam and Heat Wave freely under Drought. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks all priority (FakeOut/Nuzzle). Under Trick Room, my 49-63 Spe mons outspeed their 132-167 range. Plan for G3 if needed: consider Rotom-Wash for Hydro Pump pressure if they adapt lead.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolving activates Drought and gives Venusaur Chlorophyll speed. Charizard is guaranteed faster than Gholdengo and Heat Wave is super-effective into it before Power Gem can land; Sleep Powder is the direct denial of Farigiraf’s Trick Room. This pressures both foes rather than conceding their primary mode.

Power Gem is near-guaranteed OHKO on CharY (97.8-207.2%). Farigiraf Protects to dodge Heat Wave and Sleep Powder. If CharY barely survives, Gholdengo falls but Farigiraf survives, and incoming Mudsdale/Azumarill clean up under Trick Room. Safest high-value line.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games (consistent). G1 Venusaur Protected turn 5. CharY uses SolarBeam and Heat Wave freely under Drought. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks priority. Under Trick Room, my 49-63 Spe mons outspeed 132-167 range. Plan for G3 if needed: Rotom-Wash for Hydro Pump pressure if they adapt lead.

decisions.rationale: Both foes move before Charizard and Venusaur under Trick Room; Gholdengo has a super-effective Power Gem into Charizard while Farigiraf threatens super-effective Psychic into Venusaur. Double Protect denies their strongest immediate line and burns another Trick Room turn without risking the sun endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Farigiraf-centered Trick Room. Farigiraf has Armor Tail, Sitrus Berry, Sassy nature, and Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect. Gholdengo is Quiet Life Orb with Power Gem, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, and Protect. Anti-TR plan remains sun Charizard Y plus Venusaur sleep pressure; stall Trick Room when both active attackers are exposed.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, Gholdengo (93 Spe) moves before CharY (132-167). Power Gem is guaranteed OHKO on CharY (4x effective). Farigiraf Psychic hits Venusaur for 47-85%. This removes the biggest threat (CharY Heat Wave OHKOs Gholdengo) and pressures Venusaur. Farigiraf's Protect success rate is reduced, so attacking is safer.
decisions.notebook: G1-G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder reliably. Under Trick Room, my slow mons (49-93 Spe) outspeed their fast mons. CharY Heat Wave OHKOs Gholdengo. Venusaur uses Sleep Powder often. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if they adapt lead.

decisions.rationale: Both current actives are guaranteed to move after the relevant opposing attackers in Trick Room and face immediate OHKOs from Power Gem and Psychic. Double-switching converts both expected direct hits to neutral damage and preserves the sun/sleep endgame. Garchomp and Primarina also give viable post-room pressure while forcing Gholdengo to respect Garchomp.

Mudsdale is immune to Earthquake, neutralizing Garchomp's best threat. Make It Rain pressures both foes simultaneously. Under Trick Room, Farigiraf (72) switches first, then Gholdengo (93) attacks before Garchomp (134-169) moves. If Garchomp uses EQ, it hits Primarina too, deterring it. Dragon Claw (28.5-48.8%) and Rock Slide (6.3-11.1%) are manageable on Mudsdale. This sets up a strong endgame: Mudsdale+Gholdengo vs chipped Garchomp+Primarina under remaining Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Trick Room reverses speed. Garchomp EQ threatens Gholdengo (2x). Farigiraf burned has limited longevity. Mudsdale EQ-immune. Under TR, Mudsdale (49) is fastest. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if they adapt lead. Garchomp Life Orb+Rough Skin, Primarina Wise Glasses Moonblast/Ice Beam.

decisions.rationale: Double Protect denies the immediate Psychic/Dazzling Gleam plus Life Orb Make It Rain line and burns a Trick Room turn without exposing either attacker. Attacking Farigiraf risks its Protect while Gholdengo removes Primarina; Earthquake would also hit Primarina. Preserve both pieces for the final Trick Room turn and sun endgame.

Primarina Ice Beam threatens Mudsdale's life. Under Trick Room, Mudsdale (49) moves first, so Protect guarantees safety. Gholdengo Make It Rain pressures both foes regardless of speed order; even if Primarina Protects, Garchomp takes heavy damage. Life Orb recoil acceptable at 90% HP. This preserves both Pokémon for the end of Trick Room next turn.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Trick Room reverses speed. Mudsdale EQ-immune, Stamina boosts Defense on hit. Garchomp Life Orb+Rough Skin contact penalty. Primarina Wise Glasses Moonblast/Ice Beam. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if they adapt lead. Farigiraf burned has limited longevity; consider sac if needed.

decisions.rationale: Mudsdale is guaranteed to move before Garchomp in the final Trick Room turn and High Horsepower KOs Garchomp. Switching to Flying-type Charizard makes that likely Ground attack ineffective, while Primarina’s Ice Beam is guaranteed to OHKO Mudsdale before Gholdengo acts. This preserves both attackers better than risking reduced-success Protect.

Power Gem on Charizard (64.3-91.5% at -2 SpA vs 63% HP, likely KO) + High Horsepower on Primarina (guaranteed KO at 13% HP, 95% accuracy). If Charizard KOs Gholdengo first, Mudsdale still removes Primarina, leaving 1v2 but manageable. Safer than 80% Stone Edge for the KO on Charizard.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale EQ-immune, Stamina boosts Defense on hit. Garchomp Life Orb+Rough Skin contact penalty. Primarina Wise Glasses Moonblast/Ice Beam. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if they adapt lead. Farigiraf burned, limited longevity. Gholdengo -2 SpA, Power Gem on Charizard does 64.3-91.5% at -2, still threatening. Mudsdale High Horsepower 95% accuracy reliable. Opponent likely switches weak Primarina to Garchomp or Venusaur.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf at 59% risks KO from combined Moonblast+Heat Wave. Protect blocks both, scouting opponent's intent. Azumarill's priority Aqua Jet threatens the 13% Primarina before it acts. Next turn Trick Room reverses speed for board control.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale EQ-immune, Stamina. Garchomp Life Orb+Rough Skin. Primarina Wise Glasses Moonblast/Ice Beam. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if adapt. Gholdengo -2 SpA, Power Gem still threatening. Farigiraf burned, limited longevity.

decisions.rationale: Charizard is guaranteed faster than Gholdengo and Heat Wave guarantees its KO if it does not Protect. Primarina is guaranteed faster than Mudsdale and Ice Beam guarantees its KO if it does not Protect. This covers either single Protect and can remove both attackers before they act; Mudsdale's repeat Protect is reduced.

Liquidation with Huge Power/Mystic Water is a guaranteed OHKO on Charizard-Mega-Y (108.6-203.9%). Farigiraf Protect blocks both Heat Wave and Moonblast, ensuring survival. This removes the fastest threat, leaves Primarina at 13% alone, and sets up a favorable 2v1 next turn.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale EQ-immune, Stamina. Garchomp Life Orb+Rough Skin. Primarina Wise Glasses Moonblast/Ice Beam. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if adapt. Gholdengo -2 SpA. Farigiraf burned, limited longevity. Azumarill Huge Power Liquidation OHKOs CharY.

decisions.rationale: Both active Pokémon are in guaranteed-KO range from the foes’ direct attacks. Double Protect is the only line that denies both immediate KOs without exposing Garchomp or Venusaur to a free attack, while also scouting whether Farigiraf commits to Trick Room or attacks.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: CharY outspeeds and KOs Farigiraf with any attack. Protecting Farigiraf (~50% success) is the only way to keep it alive. Play Rough guarantees Primarina KO at 13% HP. If Protect works, both survive and Primarina falls; if it fails, Farigiraf dies but Primarina still dies. Azumarill survives Heat Wave (32-54%). Next turn Liquidation on CharY for the win.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale EQ-immune Stamina. Garchomp Life Orb Rough Skin Jolly Speed 134-169. Primarina Wise Glasses Modest Moonblast/Ice Beam 80-112 Speed. Azumarill Huge Power Liquidation possible KO on CharY (50-114% at 63% HP). Trick Room benefits slower Azumarill. G3 plan: Rotom-Wash if adapt. Farigiraf burned limits longevity. Protect success rate reduced for Farigiraf, CharY, and Primarina this turn.

decisions.rationale: Remove Farigiraf now with two attacks before it can establish Trick Room. Charizard is faster than Azumarill, but Solar Beam does not ensure the immediate board control that eliminating Farigiraf provides. If Azumarill targets Charizard, Primarina remains to support the Garchomp/Venusaur endgame; if it Aqua Jets Primarina, Charizard remains positioned against Azumarill.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Farigiraf-centered Trick Room. Farigiraf is Sassy Armor Tail with Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, and Protect; its Sitrus is consumed. Gholdengo was Quiet Life Orb with Power Gem, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, Protect. Continue prioritizing Farigiraf removal or sleep pressure before committing slower pieces; Charizard Y plus Venusaur remains the anti-TR mode.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur is the stronger endgame partner: under Charizard's sun it outspeeds, threatens Azumarill with Energy Ball/Solar Beam pressure, and can use Sleep Powder to deny Farigiraf's Trick Room. Garchomp is highly vulnerable to Azumarill's Play Rough and offers less immediate control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Farigiraf-centered Trick Room mode remains the key structural plan. Farigiraf is Sassy Armor Tail with Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Protect, and consumed Sitrus; Gholdengo was Quiet Life Orb. Against this mode, preserve Charizard Y + Venusaur when possible: sun-enabled Venusaur provides fast Sleep Powder and Grass pressure, while prioritize denying or removing Farigiraf before committing slower endgame pieces.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Azumarill)
decisions.rationale: No valid decision (empty response); defaulted to the first legal option for each slot.

Aqua Jet can KO Charizard before Solar Beam, so Protect denies the free priority KO. Sludge Bomb is Venusaur's immediate super-effective pressure into Azumarill while Charizard remains available to remove it next turn. Sleeping Farigiraf is tempting but leaves Azumarill unchecked; sacrificing Charizard is worse for the endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has repeatedly used Farigiraf Protect to stall while its partner attacks; account for its heavily reduced consecutive-Protect odds when deciding whether to double it. Preserve Charizard plus Venusaur against the Farigiraf Trick Room mode when possible; Venusaur's Grass/Poison pressure is the clean answer to Azumarill, while Charizard provides endgame damage once priority pressure is removed.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room Azumarill (63) moves first → Liquidation guaranteed-KOs 63% Charizard. Then Farigiraf (72) Psychic hits Venusaur for 43-94% before Venusaur acts. Even if Venusaur KOs Azumarill next, Farigiraf finishes with Psychic next turn. Charizard's reduced Protect odds make Protect gamble unreliable for opponent.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale Stamina EQ-immune. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly 134-169 Spe. Primarina Wise Glasses Modest 80-112 Spe. Azumarill Huge Power Mystic Water Liquidation guaranteed KOs CharY at 63% HP. Farigiraf burned. CharY Protect success rate reduced. G3: Lead Farigiraf+Azumarill again if safe, or consider bringing something to handle Venusaur better. Rotom-Wash strong vs CharY+Venusaur core.

decisions.rationale: Charizard cannot safely remain versus priority Aqua Jet. Switching to Garchomp removes the immediate Water attack line; Venusaur reliably removes Azumarill. Even if Azumarill correctly Play Roughs Garchomp, the resulting Charizard/Venusaur endgame versus burned Farigiraf is favorable.
decisions.notebook: Opponent repeatedly uses Farigiraf Protect to stall while its partner attacks; its consecutive Protect odds are reduced after repeated use. Preserve Charizard and Venusaur when possible against Farigiraf Trick Room modes. Venusaur is the primary Azumarill answer; remove Azumarill priority before relying on Charizard.

decisions.rationale: Dazzling Gleam is the only line with a win condition: KO Garchomp first under Trick Room, then if Venusaur uses Sleep Powder and misses (17.5% miss chance), Psychic finishes Venusaur next turn. Psychic on Venusaur loses if Garchomp attacks (its optimal play). Protect just delays the 2v1.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale Stamina EQ-immune. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly 134-169 Spe. Primarina Wise Glasses Modest 80-112 Spe. Azumarill Huge Power Mystic Water Liquidation guaranteed KOs CharY at 63%. Farigiraf burned. CharY Protect success rate reduced. G3: Lead Farigiraf+Azumarill again if safe; Rotom-Wash strong vs CharY+Venusaur core. My Farigiraf at 34% is fragile; any neutral hit KOs. Opponent's Venusaur at 19% and Garchomp at 8% both prefer aggressive plays.

decisions.rationale: Preserve both low-HP Pokémon while bringing Charizard in safely. Garchomp Protect blocks a possible Psychic or Dazzling Gleam, while Farigiraf’s likely attack into the switching slot is survivable for Charizard. Burn further lowers Farigiraf, and Charizard’s Air Slash is a guaranteed KO from its shown HP.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has repeatedly used Farigiraf Protect to stall while its partner attacks; consecutive Protect odds fall after repeated uses. Preserve Charizard and Venusaur against Farigiraf Trick Room modes. Venusaur is the primary Azumarill answer; remove Azumarill priority before relying on Charizard.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, Farigiraf moves first. Dazzling Gleam guarantees Garchomp KO while chipping Charizard. Every line loses because Charizard OHKOs Farigiraf regardless, but Dazzling Gleam is the most impactful — removes one threat and deals 4.3-7.8% chip before inevitable loss. Protect only delays the same outcome.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur both games. Gholdengo blocks Sleep Powder. Mudsdale Stamina EQ-immune. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly 134-169 Spe. Primarina Wise Glasses Modest 80-112 Spe. Azumarill Huge Power Mystic Water Liquidation guaranteed KOs CharY at 63%. Rotom-Wash strong vs CharY+Venusaur core. G3: If I survive to G3, consider Rotom-W lead; Farigiraf+Azumarill lead was fine but Azumarill fell to Venusaur Sludge Bomb. Need safer switch-in for Venusaur.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf moves first in Trick Room, but Solar Beam is a guaranteed KO from its shown range if it does not Protect. Dragon Claw adds a 100%-accurate second KO attempt and avoids Rock Slide/Heat Wave accuracy. If Farigiraf Protects, burn and the final Trick Room turn still leave Charizard positioned to finish.
decisions.notebook: Opponent commonly uses Farigiraf Protect to stall while its partner attacks; account for repeated-Protect odds. Preserve Charizard and Venusaur against Farigiraf Trick Room modes. Venusaur is the primary Azumarill answer; remove Azumarill priority before relying on Charizard.

reflections.summary: Lost because the opponent's Sun core (Charizard-Mega-Y + Venusaur) overwhelmed the player's slower Trick Room team. Azumarill was chipped down by Venusaur's Sludge Bomb and Energy Ball before it could secure KOs, and Farigiraf alone couldn't break through Charizard after Garchomp fell. The early faints of Gholdengo and Mudsdale left too few answers to the Sun duo.
reflections.adjustment: For the next game (if any), lead with a faster, more resilient core that can handle Sun directly—consider Rotom-Wash over Azumarill to resist Charizard's Fire and Venusaur's Grass, and pair it with Farigiraf or Gholdengo to block Sleep Powder. Avoid relying on Azumarill as the primary offensive threat against Venusaur, as its typing is vulnerable to both Sludge Bomb and Energy Ball. Also, bring a stronger answer to Garchomp, such as Mudsdale's Body Press or a Fairy-type with coverage.
reflections.notebook: G2: Opponent led CharY+Venusaur again. Gholdengo and Mudsdale fainted early, leaving Farigiraf+Azumarill vs CharY+Venusaur. Azumarill fell to Venusaur's super-effective moves (Sludge Bomb, Energy Ball). Trick Room set but not capitalized. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly, Primarina Wise Glasses Modest. CharY Timid with Solar Beam. G3: If alive, lead Rotom-Wash + Farigiraf or Gholdengo to resist Sun core. Rotom-Wash threatens CharY and Venusaur, and can pivot. Azumarill is too frail against Venusaur; consider replacing with a bulky Water or Fairy that can take hits. Mudsdale's Stamina is useful but needs to avoid being worn down early. Opponent's Protect usage was frequent (CharY used Protect 3 times).

reflections.summary: Won because Mega Charizard Y plus Venusaur gave strong endgame pressure into Azumarill and Farigiraf, allowing Azumarill to be removed before Trick Room could convert into a winning sweep. The four brought and Mega Y were appropriate for this opponent’s Trick Room mode.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the Charizard Y/Venusaur core next game, but prioritize denying or safely stalling Farigiraf’s Trick Room while Venusaur removes Azumarill; do not expose Venusaur to Farigiraf Psychic unnecessarily.
reflections.notebook: Opponent’s slow mode is centered on Farigiraf setting Trick Room, using Protect repeatedly to stall, and enabling slow attackers. Preserve Charizard and Venusaur against this mode. Venusaur remains the primary Azumarill answer; remove Azumarill before relying on Charizard. Plan to pressure Farigiraf’s Trick Room turns without leaving Venusaur exposed to Psychic.
